program.section_heading: Associate in Arts in Economics for Transfer - AA-T - Requirements
outcomes: Identify the three macroeconomic goals and determine economic policies to achieve them.

Explain how deviations from the optimal output level might occur including an analysis of the impact of taxes, externalities, and price controls by correctly applying these issues to the demand and supply model.
Apply marginal benefit marginal opportunity cost analysis to economic decisions made by individuals, households, businesses, and/or governments.
Determine the type of industrial organization/market structure by analyzing the characteristics of an industry to determine its degree of competition.
careers: data collection for various government and private sector entities
